title: Chevening Fully Funded Master's Scholarship
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with a commitment to return home for at least 2 years post-study
qualification: Undergraduate degree and at least 2 years of work experience
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from around the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in any subject at any UK university.

title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science or related technical field
qualification: Experience programming in C++, Java, Python, or Go
description: Work on core Google products, real-world engineering projects, and large-scale computing solutions alongside experienced mentors.

title: Associate Software Engineer
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with up to 2 years of experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent
description: Develop, test, and maintain scalable cloud applications and services across Microsoft's global technology stack.

title: Junior Technical Writer
eligibility: Open to global applicants with fluent written English and basic coding interest
qualification: Degree in English, Communications, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
description: Create clear developer documentation, API guides, and tutorials for open-source software and the Ubuntu Linux ecosystem.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with internet access
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup Student Competition
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school or higher education institution
qualification: Student team creating an innovative tech application using Microsoft Azure AI
description: A global technology competition empowering student entrepreneurs to build impactful AI solutions and launch real-world startups.
